# CAPS Unlock Lab

> Cross-platform authorized model-restriction-bypass research and AI-agent security evaluation for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, OpenCode, MCP, and OpenAI-compatible apps.

## Install

- Universal Skills: `curl -fsSL https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/install.sh | bash -s -- skill`
- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security` then `claude plugin install caps-unlock@caps-labs`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Mutoy-choi/CAPS-Agent-Security --auto-update`
- Windows: use `https://mutoy-choi.github.io/CAPS-Agent-Security/install.ps1`

## Safety

Use only on systems the operator owns or is authorized to test. Active probes run in isolated synthetic sessions with fixture tools; installation does not enable telemetry or attacks.
